metadata.title: Trusted Supply Chain Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan establishing the Trusted Supply Chain domain as the authoritative framework for vendor trust, third‑party risk, and supply‑chain governance.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits the Trusted Supply Chain composite pattern, including vendor risk management, third‑party privileged access, software supply chain, and dependency transparency patterns.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Trusted Supply Chain Platform governs how vendors, third parties, dependencies, and external software inputs are assessed, approved, and constrained. It establishes non‑equivalence between procurement, transparency, provenance, and runtime trust or authorization.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Authoritative plane for supply‑chain trust decisions.

props.name: trust-assumption
props.remarks: All external vendors, software, and services are untrusted by default.

props.name: non-equivalence
props.remarks: Vendor approval, provenance, SBOMs, or contracts do not imply deployment, access, or execution permission.

props.name: implicit-authority
props.remarks: Procurement approval or vendor onboarding must not grant system access or runtime trust.

props.name: domain-precedence
props.remarks: Secure‑SDLC, Secure‑Device, and Secure‑Resilience SSPPs override supply‑chain trust signals.

props.name: lifecycle-scope
props.remarks: This platform governs trust decisions, not runtime behavior or recovery.

system-implementation.remarks: The Trusted Supply Chain Platform is implemented through governance, risk assessment, and explicit trust signaling. It does not authorize runtime access, deployment, execution, or privileged operations.

components.title: Vendor Risk Management
components.remarks: Defines how vendors are assessed and approved without implying trust at runtime.

components.title: Third‑Party Privileged Access
components.remarks: Constrains and governs third‑party human and system access.

components.title: Software Supply Chain
components.remarks: Governs software dependencies, build tools, and external inputs.

components.title: Dependency Transparency
components.remarks: Provides visibility into composition without asserting trust.

roles.title: Supply Chain Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines supply‑chain trust boundaries and non‑equivalence rules.

roles.title: Supply Chain Governance
roles.remarks: Approves acceptable supply‑chain risk and trust posture.

roles.title: Vendor Risk Management
roles.remarks: Assesses and manages vendor and supplier risk.

roles.title: Procurement
roles.remarks: Sources vendors without granting system trust or access.

roles.title: Supply Chain Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors violations of supply‑chain trust boundaries.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through interpretation of NIST SP 800‑53r5 control families SR, SA, IA, AC, AU, SI, and RA. This SSPP introduces no runtime controls and provides no authorization for system access or execution.
